citations.quote: 三月上旬sell put至今，三個多月，只計算占用10%的資金，sell put sell call帶來的賬面收益19%，約為股票組合創收1.9%。
這可能與sell put主力對象$阿里巴巴-SW(09988)$ $腾讯控股(00700)$ $中国太保(02601)$ 這幾個月走勢溫和向上有關，實驗繼續…
所以還要實驗，如果是700，sell put和持有實股就就差很遠了。

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: He sizes and reports his fully collateralized sell-put/sell-call sleeve against the whole book, not the deployed slice: a 19% gain on the ~10% of capital used over three-plus months is only ~1.9% to the total portfolio. The result is regime-dependent (underlyings drifted mildly up), so he keeps the sleeve a modest, no-leverage experiment not meant for ordinary investors.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Honest Attribution of the Option-Selling Sleeve: 19% on 10% of Capital Is Only 1.9% to the Book
